Button Generator

Design a custom button with your text, colors, border radius, padding and shadow — then copy the generated CSS and use it anywhere.

📖 How to use

  1. Type your button text and pick colors.
  2. Adjust border radius and padding with the sliders.
  3. Toggle a shadow on or off.
  4. Copy the generated CSS and paste it into your site.

❓ Frequently asked questions

How do I use the CSS on my website?

Click Copy CSS, then paste the .my-button block into your stylesheet and add class=“my-button” to any button or link element.

Can I make a pill-shaped button?

Yes — drag the border radius slider to its maximum (50px) for a fully rounded pill shape.

Does the shadow work on dark backgrounds?

The default soft black shadow shows best on light backgrounds. You can edit the box-shadow line in the copied CSS to suit your design.
